setup.text: A navigator imagines borders drawn across land, with guards deciding who may pass.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A hunter argues that communities sometimes need to protect scarce resources.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent asks what happens when a child needs to cross for safety.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villagers consider why families might leave home: work, curiosity, danger, or love.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A traveler wonders how strangers might be welcomed without ignoring practical limits.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A cartographer observes that a line on a map may cross an older trail or homeland.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The council asks who has the power to draw the line.
